description: Bumps the pins Dependabot cannot read: the language-server manifests in packages/loxel/scripts/language-servers/, the Go toolchain and Bun. Dependabot keeps everything it covers (.github/dependabot.yml), so only custom managers run here. See packages/loxel/docs/LANGUAGE_SERVERS.md.

customManagers.description: A manifest's version, from the registry its pkg:golang or pkg:github purl names: Go modules, or a GitHub repository's releases (tags when it pins no release assets). The tag is the purl's version, so its prefix around {version} is stripped.

Each pinned release asset of a manifest, one dependency per asset since Renovate updates one digest per dependency. Its key, `<release tag>/<target>`, repeats the tag beside the version the dependency above updates, and its depName is the target, so Renovate finds the tag to replace in this asset's own key.
The Go toolchain the Go language servers build with. Version only: go.dev is not a source Renovate can hash.
Bun, which CI installs from .bun-version and compiles into loxel-server and the CLIs.

packageRules.description: One pull request per manifest: its version and every asset pinned from the same release.
Built from a commit of its main branch in a wrapper module that Dependabot raises.
Version only: the download is not a GitHub release asset, so a person completes the pin. A draft until then, since not every one of these builds in CI.

prBodyNotes: **Version only.** Before merging, set `GO_SHA256` in `packages/loxel/scripts/go-toolchain.ts` to the new archives' digests from https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json. Until then the toolchain download fails its hash check. Mark the PR ready when done.

**Version only.** Before merging, set `ARCHIVE`'s build timestamp and `SHA256` in `packages/loxel/scripts/download-jdtls.ts` from `latest.txt` and the archive's `.sha256` in https://download.eclipse.org/jdtls/milestones/{{{newVersion}}}/. Until then the download fails; CI does not build jdtls, so run `pnpm -C packages/loxel run build:language-servers jdtls`. Mark the PR ready when done.

**Version only.** Before merging, set `SHA256` in `packages/loxel/scripts/build-eslint-language-server.ts` to the hash of https://codeload.github.com/microsoft/vscode-eslint/tar.gz/refs/tags/release/{{{newVersion}}}, raise any loxel dependency below what the tag's `server/package.json` names, and run `src/server/eslint-language-server.test.ts`. Until then the download fails its hash check. Mark the PR ready when done.
